eps.ov: "An Invasion!? Florsheim's Strategist" At the hideout of the Kawasaki branch of the evil organization Florsheim, which plots world domination, a strategy meeting filled with unusual tension was being held, centered around General Vamp. What was on the agenda? Was it a plan to eliminate their arch-enemy, Astro Fighter Sunred, or something else...!?

"Florsheim: A Simulation of Terror" Gamess, a turtle-shaped monster from the Kawasaki branch of the evil organization Florsheim, plots world domination. Even he needs a rest. But who is the dark shadow that visits his home late at night...?

"Ancient Monsters Run into Modern Civilization!" On a pleasant afternoon, Khamenman, Medaleo, Usacots, and others surrounded a car in front of the hideout of the evil organization Florsheim's Kawasaki branch. What exactly is their aim as they plot world domination...?

"The man who saw hell in Kawasaki" Even Sunred, the hero of justice who protects the peace of Kawasaki City, gets rest. As Sunred walks along the riverbank with Kayoko, a cheerful shadow creeps up from behind—it's once again General Vamp, a high-ranking member of the evil organization Florsheim...!?

"Seminga Cast Off!!" Combat Goons 1 and 2 of the Kawasaki branch of the evil organization Florsheim, which plots world domination, make their way through the city in the afternoon. Their destination is the home of the organization's cicada-like monster, Seminga! What will they see when they open the door to Seminga's house...?

"Good vs. Evil: A Deadly Battle in Kawasaki" Sunred, the hero of justice who protects the peace of Kawasaki, and the members of the Kawasaki branch of the evil organization plotting world domination, face off in a life-or-death battle today. The monster prepared by General Vamp is Armor Lion. Red unleashes an uncharacteristic level of aggression against this monster with unparalleled strength...!?
"Ganymede's Wrath" Ganymede is a monster from the Kawasaki branch of the evil organization Florsheim, which plots world domination. He has a complaint. What is his pressing complaint...?

"Florsheim's Hellish Summer Vacation" In the height of summer, while everyone else is enjoying a scorching hot summer vacation, what kind of plan does Florsheim's monster Khamenman get proposed to by his younger brother Ant Killer...!?

"The third man, the 'Warrior of Thunder,' appears!" Ando and Trois, monsters from the Florsheim Kawasaki branch, are waiting in line at a credit union branch when they hear a shocking announcement...!?

"Florsheim: The Devil's Scientific Power" Florsheim is an evil organization plotting world domination. What is the new weapon, the pinnacle of scientific power, that the organization's headquarters has bestowed upon its Kawasaki branch...?

"Landing! Jargo the Madman" On a pleasant afternoon, Red is riding the Nambu Line when he hears a voice from nowhere! It's General Vamp of the evil organization Florsheim, which is plotting world domination! Pleased with the chance encounter on the train, Vamp reveals to Red who his new assassin is...!?

"Armor Tiger's Battle" A shadow visits the home of Armor Tiger, a monster from the evil organization Florsheim. It is his fellow monster, Ganymede. What secret meeting are these two monsters having in a room in a peaceful residential area in broad daylight?

"Mysterious visitors appear!" It's another peaceful day in Kawasaki City. Three shadows are closing in on the hideout of the Kawasaki branch of the evil organization Florsheim. Who are they, and what is their purpose...?

"2010: Florsheim vs. Sunred - The War Begins!?" New Year's Day. On this auspicious day, the members of the Kawasaki branch of the evil organization Florsheim, which plots world domination, are gathered on the banks of the Tama River, waiting for Sunred, the warrior of the sun. What is their ultimate plan!?

"Shocking!! The Trading of Monsters!?" 2010, Year of the Tiger. The first battle of the year is over, and the Florsheim Kawasaki branch has suffered another defeat at the hands of Red. The world has been saved once again, but Red is in a bad mood despite his victory. What could be the reason?

"Florsheim's Double-Edged Blade Operation" Spring is approaching. Florsheim and Sunred face off as usual in their usual park. However, something strange is happening on Florsheim's side, led by General Vamp! What could be the cause?!

"Stunned!? Vamp becomes a demon!!" The evil organization Florsheim plots world domination. Today, an unusual training exercise is being held at the Kawasaki branch hideout, bringing together all the monsters! What exactly is going on!? And General Vamp's rage explodes upon the monsters who fail the training!

"Loafer has landed!" The usual showdown between the Florsheim Kawasaki branch and Sunred. In the battleground where good and evil will be decided, an inappropriate laughter echoes!! Who is laughing!? And what is the reason!?

"The Terrifying Melody! The Pied Piper's Trap!!" A new monster, Rigi, has been assigned to the Kawasaki branch. He doesn't look like he has much fighting ability, so why was he chosen as the assassin to eliminate Red? What are his techniques!?

"Florsheim: The Terrifying Mental Training" The organization's long-held ambition is world domination. To achieve this, improving combat power is essential. Mental strength is one of those essential elements. What kind of mental training lesson did Ant Killer, the monster of the Kawasaki branch, impart to his juniors, Mogira and Mogera!?

"Tiger and Lion: A Terrifying Tag Team!?" Armor Tiger and Armor Lion, two monsters from Florsheim, glare at Red. Before their showdown with their arch-enemy, allies have begun to antagonize each other! And in the enemy's room, no less!!

"A man recognized by a man with an IQ of 150"—a suspicious figure walks down Omotesando. It is General Hengel of the West Tokyo branch of the evil organization Florsheim, which plots world domination. As he walks away after finishing a meeting with a weapons dealer, two even more suspicious figures follow him from the shadows!! Where are they going!?

"Florsheim's New Enemy" Autumn, the season of hearty appetites. When Sunred went to a confrontation one day, he witnessed the horribly changed appearances of Vamp, Khamenman, and Medaleo. What words did Red utter to them in their presence!?

The Kawasaki branch of Florsheim is preparing for its annual showdown with Sunred against "Bon Odori Monster Bon Odora." However, today the monster is holed up on the second floor of his hideout and won't come out. What is his claim? And what is the surprising reason behind it!?

"A Ruthless Showdown! A Friend Who Sold His Soul to the Devil!!" The now-familiar confrontation with Florsheim. As usual, Red heads to the riverbank where he was summoned, only to find his former friend transformed into a monster!!

"The fate of love and romance" Kayoko is packing in her room. With the end of the year fast approaching and everyone busy, she has to go back to her hometown for an urgent matter. That matter is a "marriage interview"—. To Red, who is worried about her absence, Kayoko asks him to "attend a mochi-making festival" while she's gone. Kayoko leaves, leaving the grumpy Red behind. What is Red thinking as he is left behind...?
